subject: Veridian Health - Security questionnaire, PHI handling clarifications & BAA scope
messages:
From: Alicia Mendoza <alicia.mendoza@veridianhealth.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Cc: James Park <j.park@veridianhealth.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Veridian security questionnaire and BAA scope

Hi Elliot,

Thanks for agreeing to take our security questionnaire — attached is Veridian's standard security & privacy questionnaire (spreadsheet) and a short template of the BAA scope we prefer. For context: the pilot will process PHI for a small subset of patients (~15k records initially) and we're evaluating providers who can support a dedicated or VPC-hosted deployment.

Two quick asks up front:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood will act as a \"service provider\" that can sign a full BAA (we typically require this for any PHI-processing vendor)?
- Please indicate which deployment models you support for regulated PHI (hosted with dedicated pools, private VPC, on-prem).

If you can return a completed questionnaire and a redlineable BAA by EOD next Friday (2026-10-16), that would help our procurement timeline. Also, please include a SOC 2 report and high-level details on key management (KMS/HSM) and audit logs/retention.

I've copied our technical lead James and procurement so we can route questions quickly.

Thanks,
Alicia Mendoza
Head of Vendor Security 
Veridian Health
Alicia.Mendoza@veridianhealth.com

Attachment: Veridian_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet, 78 KB)
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Mendoza <alicia.mendoza@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Veridian security questionnaire and BAA scope

Hi Alicia — thanks for the questionnaire and the clear timeline. We're able to sign a BAA; I've attached our initial draft (redwood_baa_draft_v1.pdf) that legal prefers to start from. Couple of clarifications before we complete the spreadsheet:

1) PHI residency & deployment model
   - For production-grade PHI workloads we recommend Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) or Private (VPC) deployments. Our hosted multitenant offering is not recommended for regulated PHI without an explicit exception.
   - Can you confirm whether you need data physically in a single US region or multi-region? We support single-region US deployments and also EU-only deployments for EU customers.

2) Retention & deletion workflow
   - On the questionnaire we'll note that retention is configurable per-customer; we can implement retention/auto-deletion policies and provide a deletion playbook for audit. Please indicate your default retention window so we can populate the response.

3) Evidence bundle
   - We'll attach SOC 2 Type II summary, our KMS integration sheet, and a filled questionnaire (RI_Veridian_Questionnaire_Responses.xlsx). If you need full SOC2 artifacts, we can provide under NDA/controlled access.

Proposed next steps:
- We will return the completed questionnaire and the BAA redline by 2026-10-16.
- Suggest a 30-minute technical call this week to walk PHI flows (we can have Connor join to cover deployment options). Available slots: Tue 10/13 09:30-11:00 PT or Thu 10/15 13:00-15:00 PT.

Let me know which slot works and your preference for data residency.

Best,
Elliot Price
Head of Compliance & Security Programs
Redwood Inference
elliot.price@redwood.com

Attachments: RI_Veridian_Questionnaire_Responses.xlsx (spreadsheet, 62 KB); redwood_baa_draft_v1.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)

Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Veridian security questionnaire and BAA scope

Thanks Elliot — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from our side:

- Residency: For the initial pilot we require US-only residency and single-region (us-west-2 preferred).
- Retention: Our baseline retention for this dataset is 7 years, but for model inference logs we typically ask for 180 days; the questionnaire has both items separated but please confirm both.
- SOC 2: We need either a SOC 2 Type II report or a link to a hosted evidence portal. A one-page summary is fine for initial review.

I'm attaching a short diagram of the PHI workflow we expect (Veridian_PHI_Workflow.docx) — it shows ingestion, transformation, inference, and downstream archiving. Please confirm where Redwood would have access to raw PHI vs. derived outputs and whether Redwood will be able to support our requirement that raw PHI is deleted at the application layer after ingestion.

We can take the call on Tue 10/13 10:00 PT if you can do 30 minutes — that works for James and me. Procurement is asking us to target a contract signature by end of October; if Redwood can commit to the 10/16 deliverable that will keep us on track.

Thanks,
Alicia

Attachment: Veridian_PHI_Workflow.docx (diagram, 220 KB)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Mendoza <alicia.mendoza@veridianhealth.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Veridian security questionnaire and BAA scope — technical call and evidence list

Hi Alicia — great diagram, thanks. I'll join the 10:00 PT call.

High-level notes I can cover on the call and in the evidence packet:
- Deployment options: Dedicated (recommended) and Private VPC (customer-managed peering). We can run dedicated GPU pools in a single-region (us-west-2).
- Data access: Redwood never persists raw input to multitenant storage for Dedicated/VPC deployments. For Dedicated we store model artifacts and ephemeral KV cache; raw PHI ingestion can be routed directly into customer-controlled storage in the VPC with Redwood compute accessing it over private networking.
- KMS: We support AWS KMS and customer-provided CMKs (bring-your-own-key) via IAM roles and envelope encryption. HSM integrations available on request.
- Audit & retention: We retain request/response logs for 180 days by default and can extend/contract retention per contract (7-year cold archive can be supported via customer-managed storage). We produce immutable audit logs and provide streaming export to your SIEM.
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II summary (attached), encryption architecture diagram, deletion/playbook excerpt, and a sample audit log extract. Full SOC 2 report or behind-NDA artifacts available via secure portal.

I'll bring the SOC2 summary to the call and we'll walk the PHI flow to confirm which elements are in-scope for the BAA.

Connor O'Brien
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com

Attachment: soc2-summary.pdf (PDF, 85 KB)
